args.task_description: 实现 continue-the-source-only 功能：Continue the source-only Agent Orchestrator module in Coding Tools. Keep the existing Coding Tools plan board as durable mission board with nested clauses. WebGPT running through Codex is the AO planner and reviewer. AO alone owns worker agent creation and launch; each worker uses a user-selected harness and its exact configuration. CPA is only a model provider for eligible worker harnesses, not an orchestrator or special planner. Expose AO through Runtime UI and browser MCP with workspace-scoped permissions and local confirmation for writes. Do not bundle or launch an AO executable, and preserve unrelated dirty worktree files.

globalRules: 首次执行计划时调用 plan_heartbeat 并附完整 plan，建立本地检查点
每完成、跳过或阻塞一个步骤后调用 plan_heartbeat 更新证据与状态
会话中断或切换 Agent 后先调用 resume_plan，再继续未完成步骤
只有 converge 返回 passed=true 后，才能将本次结论正式写入长期记忆
Agent 必须按步骤顺序调用 MCP，并使用宿主能力完成真实文件与代码操作
首次执行前必须用完整 plan 建立 plan_heartbeat 检查点；每完成、跳过或阻断一步立即累计回写
check_spec 未通过前不得进入实现阶段
不得把 delegated plan 的输出误认为代码已经实施
历史记忆仅作为参考，当前项目事实与代码优先
completionCriteria: 规格文档已生成并通过 check_spec
工作量与主要风险已完成评估
Agent 已按 tasks.md 完成实现、测试与代码审查
所有步骤状态与证据已通过 plan_heartbeat 写入检查点
